operator_notes_2026_08_10: Investigated (not a recipe/selector bug): newtownkilleaparish.ie is
entirely behind a Cloudflare Managed Challenge — the homepage, /bulletin/,
and even the /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/ directory all return HTTP 403
'Just a moment...' in both headless AND headful Playwright chromium (same
signature as naomhfionan). There is no listing page to scrape to find the
true newest bulletin — use_target_url + date-rewrite guessing was tried
against the wp-content/uploads static path (which is NOT behind the
challenge) but the parish does not post every single week under a
predictable ordinal-date filename: probed ~12 candidate dates between
28 June and 10 August 2026 directly and only 28th-June and 12th-July
actually exist (200), everything else in between/since 404s — so a
target-date guess this week would 404 most weeks and turn a soft 'stale'
into a hard 'failed', which is worse. Updated the pinned URL from the old
trained 28th-June-2026.pdf to the newer confirmed-real 12th-July-2026.pdf
(verified real bulletin content, not a placeholder) — 4 weeks less stale
than before, though still stale.
Genuine dead-end without either a Cloudflare allowlist rule from the site
owner or the parish adopting a guessable weekly URL; re-probe manually
every few weeks by trying nearby wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/Newsletter-
Dth-Month-YYYY.pdf dates directly with curl.
